release_accuracy_requires: labels directly judge writing slop or editorial quality, not inferred authorship
independent human labels with a documented rubric and adjudication
source-grouped train, development, and held-out test splits with leakage checks
current-model, genre, dialect, and non-native-English coverage relevant to the release
stable provenance, content hashes, reproducible sampling, and compatible use terms
enough resolved examples to report uncertainty by genre and important subgroup
policy.rule: A corpus may support only the question its labels answer. No listed corpus currently clears every requirement for calibrated slop-quality field accuracy.

datasets.name: Zero Slop blind quality panel
datasets.license: repository test data; upstream method licenses recorded in the manifest inputs
datasets.label_semantics: blind LLM editorial labels: clean, borderline, or sloppy
datasets.intended_use: development and held-out contextual research ablation; method-level editorial comparison
datasets.result: 72 variants from 12 source drafts; 38 consensus binary labels; not field accuracy
datasets.source_pin: manifest and protocol SHA-256

datasets.name: Zero Slop cross-genre regression corpus
datasets.license: repository test data; anonymous paraphrases, not source posts
datasets.label_semantics: curated obvious-slop challenge with fact and genre-shape contracts
datasets.intended_use: deterministic regression and same-session rewrite comparison
datasets.result: 18 items across six genres; five rewriting methods replayed
datasets.source_pin: item hashes and pinned method revisions

datasets.name: Zero Slop antithesis-pair labels
datasets.label_semantics: maintainer labels on constructed adjacent-sentence pairs: antithesis or ordinary
datasets.intended_use: regression floor for the register pass's antithesis detector
datasets.result: 58 pairs; recall 90.0% overall and 100% on the 27 in reach; precision 100%
datasets.source_pin: bundled corpus.json

datasets.name: Private maintainer slop examples

datasets.label_semantics: maintainer-curated examples without per-item labels, a rubric, or clean controls
datasets.intended_use: private release drift replay and missed-case review

datasets.result: nine populated examples replayed from a hash-pinned private snapshot; not accuracy
